Hi Alice — fantastic, excited to get this moving. Thanks for sending the inventory.

Proposed next steps / kickoff agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions + objectives (5m)
2) Network topology review (CIDR, peering, route tables) (10m)
3) On-prem installer / hardware profile and local networking (10m)
4) Security/compliance expectations & evidence (SOC2 items, KMS/HSM) (7m)
5) Action items & owners, tentative timeline (5m)

Prerequisites for the technical kickoff:
- VPC CIDR ranges for your staging and prod VPCs
- Firewall rules / egress policy and any proxy/NAT appliances (IP ranges and FQDN patterns)
- SSH bastion details or jump host egress window (if applicable)
- KMS or HSM provider and whether keys will be customer-managed
- Point-of-contact for the on-prem install team (name + timezone)

I’ve attached our standard onboarding checklist and a VPC peering template for your infra team to review. Monica will lead the kickoff from Redwood and coordinate the runbook; I’ll bring the on-prem install checklist and Marcus (SE) will join for the installer validation.

Suggested times (PST):
- Tue 2026-08-10 09:30–10:15
- Tue 2026-08-10 13:00–13:45
- Wed 2026-08-11 09:00–09:45

If any of those work, I’ll calendar the meeting and include a short pre-read.

Attachments: redwood_onprem_onboarding_checklist.xlsx, vpc_peering_template.txt

Best,
Chloe Martin

Subject: INTERNAL: VelaHealth deploy runway — tasking and timelines

Team — looping you in so we can run a tight kickoff and hit a two-week runway for initial connectivity. High level: VelaHealth (DEAL-2026-0911) wants private deploy with VPC peering and an on-prem installer for a 4xA100 rack.

Immediate asks / owners:
- Monica: Own the kickoff, collect VPC CIDRs and confirm the meeting time. Drive the runbook and action tracker.
- Priyom: Network review — validate the VPC peering template against their inventory, call out any NAT/firewall gotchas, and propose route-table/AS-path recommendations.
- Marcus: SE validation — confirm the installer supports their OS/kernel, GPU drivers, and local storage layout. Prepare an installer validation checklist and a preflight script.
- Chloe: I’ll consolidate requirements and draft the initial runbook; I’ll also coordinate SOC2 evidence requests with the security team.

Timeline:
- Kickoff & topology review: this week (target: Tue or Wed)
- Network peer config & preflight windows: within 3 business days post-kickoff
- On-prem installer dry-run (staging) & acceptance: within 10 business days post-kickoff

Attachments here are the inventory from VelaHealth and the checklist/template I sent them. Please write any blockers in thread.

Thanks — Chloe

(Internal note: include Marcus on the calendar and request a staging cluster build on our side for the dry-run.)
